works.body:
Nice to meet you, my name is Kosaka Shigure.
I saw your post on X and contacted you because I would love to have you draw an illustration for me.
I would like to ask you to draw two Vtubers, Momosai Puoru (@pudoru_) and Yosuzu Yona (@yosuzuYONA).
They usually work as a unit called "Puyoniko" and are active on a regular basis.
I would like to present to them who are working hard on a daily basis.
I have permission from them to create FA art.
The composition of the picture should be like the two smiling faces, as shown in the post of November 6, 2011 by Mr. Suspending Request.
We would like to use it for social networking, distribution on monetized channels, and as a thumbnail for videos.
If possible, I would like to make it into a personalized aqukey, so I would appreciate your permission for that as well.
We would be very grateful if you could provide us with transparent PNG or PSD data of the background and characters separately so that we can use them in the video distribution.
For your reference, please refer to the following websites
Yona Yozu
https://lit.link/yosuzuyona
https://x.com/yosuzuYONA
Momosai Pudoru-san
https://lit.link/pdrofficial
https://x.com/pudoru_
